info.title: UniFi Fabric
info.description: Cloud only, via https://api.ui.com with a client-scoped Fabric key. Flow: Get Consoles -> Get Sites(consoleId) -> any action(consoleId, siteId).

get.description: Step 1. Lists this client's consoles. data[].id = consoleId, reportedState.hostname = name. Skip anything not type console or not connected.

parameters.name: consoleId
parameters.description: Console id from Get Consoles (data[].id).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter, e.g. name.like('guest*'). Fields: id, internalReference, name

get.description: Step 2. Lists sites on a console. data[].id = siteId. One site: filter=name.eq('<name>') or id.eq(<uuid>).

parameters.description: Console id from Get Consoles (data[].id).
